display.reset: DevKit EN/CHIP_PU; no separate GPIO; SWRESET on every firmware boot

shared_spi.serialization: ESP-IDF SPI master with independent device handles and chip selects

build_warnings: The first dependency-resolution configure pass reported the upstream ds18b20 optional DS18B20_SENSOR_HUB Kconfig warning and automatically reran configuration.
No compiler warning or error was emitted for the project sources; the final build completed successfully.
safety: The image requires an explicitly accepted PWM-only schema-2 configuration; fresh or schema-1 NVS fails closed with FAULT_CONFIG.
Every boot/reset enters RECOVERY_PURGE with fuel and glow off; completion requires the commissioned minimum time, fresh valid sensors, inactive STOP and cold thresholds.
Detected TFT initialization, queue or transfer failure latches FAULT_LOCAL_UI, inhibits fuel/glow and does not suppress required recovery purge airflow.
The selected seven-pin TFT exposes no MISO, TE or presence signal. SPI write success cannot prove that a physically absent panel displayed pixels.
Latched software faults persist in NVS across power loss and clear only after a qualified manual RESET exits LOCKOUT.
No verified 220/24V presence input exists; an ESP32 kept alive by USB cannot detect mains loss/return, so the recovery guarantee begins on actual MCU boot/reset.
This artifact is for bench verification only and is not authorization for fired operation.
physical_tests_required: Confirm TFT connector orientation, image orientation, RGB order, cold-start and software-reboot initialization on the exact GMT020-02-7P VER1.3 module.
Measure TFT/backlight current and verify the 3.3V rail and DevKit regulator margin.
Use a logic analyzer to confirm GPIO9, GPIO10 and GPIO47 chip selects never overlap and each device receives its configured SPI mode and clock.
Measure MAX31856 freshness, control-loop/STOP latency and watchdog falling-edge interval while the TFT refreshes continuously.
Run at least one hour with both MAX31856 channels and TFT active; check for sensor corruption, timeouts, display stalls and false watchdog/latch events.
All previous no-fuel commissioning, hardware latch, independent watchdog, PWM and thermal checks remain required.
